decision: NO-GO for a new nativeEMC organoid quantitative stage from the two selected branches
why: Accessible new primary explicitly supplies other-entity donors; distinct rPDOX primary methods/roster inaccessible via tested network route. No authenticEMC donor–organoid–public processed assay crosswalk or consequential unanswered clinical contrast established. Metadata/model establishment alone is not new biology.
usefulness: A new comparison would need to change the next measurement of an authentic EMC condition beyond established source model performance; no such proposal justified here. Culture-medium drugs and transcriptome recapitulation are not treatment/dependency evidence.
strongest_alternative: Selection of successful nonEMC models or multiple masses/technical organoids could falsely suggest native EMC generality or replication; cohort labels cannot prove patient identity or disease.
reopen: Genuine public source roster authenticating EMC and donor/model/technical condition links, finite processed file size/schema, assay/control/timing/readout with an independently useful unreported contrast and prospective frozen disproof/root-reviewed numerical stage. Obtain suitable new evidence rather than repeat unchanged failed requests.
restrictions: All denied scientific/access scopes remain closed; TMEM266 shelved; oldfreezes immutable.
